title: Preconditioned Physics-Informed Neural Operator Training
abstract: arXiv:2609.36216v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural operators are typically trained in a supervised fashion, which requires a dataset to be generated with a classical solver. Training them physics-informed, i.e., purely from the governing equations, removes this large offline cost and allows fresh samples to be drawn at every optimization step, but has so far been limited to simplified problems and trails supervised training in accuracy. The obstacle is the ill-conditioning of physics-informed losses, which differential operators induce and which worsens as the discretization is refined. We therefore propose a preconditioned residual loss function and show mesh-independent conditioning for elliptic problems and greatly improved conditioning for saddle point problems. translated_title: 预条件的物理信息神经算子训练
translated_abstract: 神经算子通常以监督方式训练，这需要用经典求解器生成数据集。而以物理信息方式训练，即纯粹从控制方程学习，可以消除这种巨大的离线成本，并允许在每个优化步骤中抽取新样本，但迄今为止仅局限于简化问题，且精度落后于监督训练。其障碍在于物理信息损失的病态性（不适定性），这种病态性由微分算子引起，并随着离散化的细化而加剧。因此，我们提出了一种预条件残差损失函数，并证明了对于椭圆问题其条件数与网格无关，而对于鞍点问题条件数也得到极大改善。该构造通过几何多重网格和代数多重网格实现，适用于线性与非线性方程、稳态与非稳态问题、结构化与非结构化网格，并且不依赖于具体的神经算子架构。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于多重网格的预条件残差损失函数，解决了物理信息神经算子训练中损失随网格细化而恶化的病态性问题，使纯物理方程驱动的训练在各类问题上达到与监督训练相竞争的精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multigrid-based preconditioned residual loss for physics-informed neural operator training, which resolves the ill-conditioning of physics-informed losses that worsens with mesh refinement and enables accurate training purely from governing equations across a broad range of problems.
